sector: Driver education and road safety training (accredited in car and classroom academy)
founded_place_size: Established 2009 in Burlington, Vermont. Small: two instructors, roughly sixty learners a term.
about: Milepost is an accredited driving academy in Vermont running in car lessons and a classroom course. Two instructors, about sixty learners a term, mostly sixteen to nineteen with a steady number of adult beginners. Our reputation is that we are calm and thorough, and every learner leaves certain about what they are looking at. Everything we make has to earn the trust of a nervous learner and the parent paying for the course.
audience: Learners sixteen to nineteen plus adult beginners, with the purchase decision usually made by a parent. People who want reassurance that the school is careful and legitimate.
price_positioning: Mid, accredited and dependable. Sixty dollars an hour. Not a budget app, not a premium driving experience brand.
typography: A plain, highly legible system: a clear humanist sans for titles and step lists, set generously, with a neutral companion for call outs and captions. Legibility at small size in a printed guide and on a phone is the whole criterion. Nothing expressive or condensed.
voice: Calm, instructive, reassuring. One idea at a time, numbered where it helps, no slang and no drama. Speaks plainly to a beginner and to the parent reading over their shoulder.
brand_assets_status: Everything a learner currently sees from us dates to 2019 and looks it. The printer holds the press file for the guide, but the source files for our simplified sign shapes are gone: they only survive as a photograph of a sheet our first designer printed and taped to the wall, so those glyphs have to be recovered from that. No brand typeface was ever locked, so the type system is open for you to set to our legibility standard.
values: Certainty over style. A learner and a parent must always be sure what they are looking at. Nothing stylised, nothing that reads as styling over substance, consistency that shows the school is careful.
